jobs.description:
**Overview**
 The Infosys SURE (Services, Utilities, Resources, Energy) unit is dedicated to empowering businesses within the services, utilities, energy, and resources sectors through strategic digital transformation. We specialize in guiding organizations through the complexities of disruption, enabling them to unlock value and realize sustainable growth. Join us to be part of a pioneering team that leverages advanced AI and digital technologies to drive innovation and operational excellence. You'll have the opportunity to work on transformative projects that shape the future of these critical industries, collaborate with industry experts, and develop resilient strategies that respond to change and seize new opportunities. If you're passionate about AI and eager to make a significant impact, the Infosys SURE unit is the perfect place for you to grow and excel
   

  

**In the assigned Job Role of Package Consultant 3, your Area Of Responsibility will be as below:**
* Analyze complex business processes to identify optimization opportunities and draft detailed requirement specifications that align with enterprise architecture standards
* Define and develop solution architecture, steering customization and integration efforts based on thorough business analysis
* Design and implement advanced customizations basis ERP platform's capabilities and limitations and develop critical software applications in collaboration with the development team
* Develop and implement complex integration workflows to connect the ERP system with external applications, while leading large\-scale data migration strategies to ensure data integrity
* Implement advanced performance optimization strategies focused on scalability, reliability, and user experience, while leading compliance initiatives throughs audits, to uphold security protocols and industry standards
* Develop detailed documentation for complex ERP customizations and lead training workshops tailored to various user groups, to ensure effective knowledge transfer


**Your Contribution To The Team**
* Expertise in ERP systems, architecture, and advanced customization techniques
* Ability to design complex integration solutions and guide large\-scale data migrations
* Proactive problem\-solving to streamline complex requirements
* A strategic mindset to align technical solutions with business goals and market trends.
* Deep understanding of compliance requirements, security protocols, and performance optimization methodologies
* Sector specific expertise for high quality project delivery


**Required Skill And Experience**
 Experience in SAP CR\&B implementation programs in at least one of the modules of ISU FICA
   

  

 Experience across Electricity (preferred), or Gas or Water Utilities industries, North America
   

  

 Experience of at least 1 end to end lifecycle implementation activities including:
   

  

 Requirement gathering
   

  

 Business process design
   

  

 SAP configuration
   

  

 RICEFW Functional design
   

  

 Systems and Integration Testing
   

  

 Resolving production issues
   

  

 Experience in setup of Org Structure, GL setup \& Integration
   

  

 Experience in Cash journal, Clearing Control, Account Assignment and Setup of Direct Debit Payments.
   

  

 Strong Understanding of Dunning Process, Collection, Installment Plan.
   

  

 Setup of Main \& Sub transaction Experience in analyzing issue in Billing \& Invoicing process.
   

  

 Good Experience in Invoice Layout \& Bill Print.
   

  

**Preferred Skill And Experience**
 Strong Client Facing experience, great communication and presentations skills.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills with ability to work in advanced excel based data analysis of SAP ISU data.
   

  

 Ability to work with offshore teams and coordinating work delivery between onsite and offshore.
   

  

 Flexible work timings required due to remote working environment including offshore overlaps twice a day.
   

  

**Additional Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
* This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location.
* All applicants authorized to work in the United States are encouraged to apply.


**Benefits**
 Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits:
   

  

* Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
* Long\-term/Short\-term Disability
* Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts
* Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal)
* 401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level
* Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off


**About Us**
 Infosys is a global leader in next\-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI\-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always\-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
   

  

**EEO**
 Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

jobs.title: SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager
jobs.description:
**SAP Application Development (AD) \& Application Management Services (AMS) Manager**


**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**


Responsible for leading and governing SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across the enterprise SAP landscape, ensuring the successful delivery of enhancements, and support services aligned to business objectives.


The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers to ensure effective planning, prioritization, execution, and support of SAP solutions. The candidate will be accountable for driving service excellence, managing vendors and delivery teams, overseeing execution, and ensuring stable SAP operations across all business\-critical processes and modules.


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**


* Lead the delivery and governance of SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across multiple SAP modules and business functions.


* Act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers.


* Manage SAP continuous improvement initiatives from inception through deployment and stabilization.


* Ensure effective delivery of AMS services, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Release Management.


* Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, ticket backlogs, aging incidents, customer satisfaction metrics, and vendor performance.


* Drive prioritization and governance of project demands, enhancement requests, and production support activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.


* Collaborate with business process owners across functions including Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Customer Service to identify and deliver technology solutions.


* Coordinate cross\-functional solution delivery involving SAP modules such as SD, MM, PP, PM, FI/CO, EWM, BRIM, and other integrated solutions as applicable.


* Manage SAP AMS provider, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality, and delivery expectations are consistently achieved.


* Lead major incident management activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement initiatives.


* Support budget planning, resource management, capacity planning, risk management, and project portfolio governance activities.


* Provide regular communication and status reporting to business leadership, IT management, and project governance boards.


* Build and maintain high\-performing SAP support and delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a customer\-focused culture.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**


**Essential**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


* Minimum 12\-15 years of SAP experience with strong understanding of end\-to\-end enterprise business processes.


* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing SAP Application Development (AD) and/or Application Management Services (AMS) teams.


* Proven experience managing SAP projects, enhancements, support services, and vendor delivery engagements.


* Deep functional expertise in Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C), with sufficient understanding of adjacent business processes and modules.


* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Level Management.


* Experience managing managed\-service providers, offshore delivery teams, and external implementation partners.


* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing demands, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex global environment.


* Experience in SAP S/4HANA environments.


* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and decision\-making skills.


* Experience managing project plans, budgets, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.


**Desirable**


* Experience managing both Application Development and AMS functions within a global SAP landscape.


* SAP certification in any functional, technical, or project management discipline.


* ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT Service Management certification.


* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or SAP Activate.


* Basic understanding of ABAP, interfaces, workflows, forms, and SAP development lifecycle.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**


* Office\-based / Remote working model.


* Responsible for ensuring compliance with company Health, Safety, Security, and Risk Management policies.


* Operates within a global support and delivery model supporting business users across APAC, Europe, and the Americas.


* Flexibility to support major incidents, critical project milestones, go\-live activities, and leadership escalations outside standard business hours when required.


* Regular engagement with senior business stakeholders, technology leadership teams, implementation partners, and managed service providers.

Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
